project.name: Level 12 and Level 14 Office Fit-Out, Meridian Point Tower
project.site_address: Meridian Point Tower, Levels 12 and 14, 88 Sampaguita Ridge Avenue, Barangay Tala Verde, City of San Lorenzo del Mar

impact.basis: Estimate only. Manual: about 6 minutes per playbook rule (30 rules) plus about 60 minutes cross-checking 5 permits and the register against the milestone schedule. With PermitPilot: about 25 minutes for the PM to verify each finding against its quoted source.

checklist_items.title: Scope defined and bounded
checklist_items.finding: The scope is set out in Annex A, and anything outside it is handled as a Variation.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The scope of the Works is limited to the items listed in Annex A. Any work not listed in Annex A shall be treated as a Variation under Clause 10.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Confirm Annex A matches the approved design and tender; record exclusions in the scope baseline.

checklist_items.title: Employer-supplied items have firm dates
checklist_items.finding: Furniture and AV equipment are supplied by the Employer 'on dates to be agreed'. No firm date or lead time is set, which could later support a delay claim under Clause 11.1(b). Unclear whether dates are fixed elsewhere (e.g. the Specifications, which were not provided).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Employer shall deliver loose furniture and the audio-visual equipment to the Site on dates to be agreed.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Agree firm delivery dates for furniture and AV and add them to the baseline schedule and interface register.

checklist_items.title: Price basis stated
checklist_items.finding: Fixed lump sum of PHP 48,750,000.00, adjustable only for Variations.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Contract Price is a fixed lump sum and is not subject to adjustment except for Variations under Clause 10
checklist_items.suggested_action: Record the lump-sum basis in the cost baseline.

checklist_items.title: Payment within 60 days
checklist_items.finding: Payment is due 90 days after invoice, 30 days beyond the 60-day policy limit. The Contractor can only terminate after a further 60 days overdue (Clause 19.2), so cash may be outstanding for up to 150 days.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Employer shall pay each certified progress claim within ninety (90) days after receipt of a valid invoice.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Negotiate payment terms to 60 days or less, or have Finance confirm the cash-flow impact and contingency.

checklist_items.title: Retention and release
checklist_items.finding: Retention is 5% (within the 10% limit), released half at Practical Completion and half after the defects period.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Employer shall retain five percent (5%) of each progress payment. Half of the retention shall be released upon Practical Completion and the balance upon expiry of the Defects Liability Period.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Track retention amounts and release dates in the cost log.

checklist_items.title: Dates, milestones and programme
checklist_items.finding: Commencement 19 Oct 2026, Practical Completion 31 Mar 2027, nine milestones in Annex B, and a programme updated every two weeks (Clause 4.3).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Contractor shall achieve each milestone listed in Annex B by the milestone dates stated in Annex B.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Load the Annex B milestones into the schedule baseline.

checklist_items.title: Extension of time incl. permit delays
checklist_items.finding: Extension of time covers Variations, Employer acts, Force Majeure and authority delays in issuing permits, with a 14-day notice requirement.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: (d) delay by a public authority in issuing a Permit, provided the Contractor applied for it on time and in full.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Set up an extension-of-time register and diarise the 14-day notice deadline.

checklist_items.title: Liquidated damages capped
checklist_items.finding: LDs are 0.5% of the Contract Price per day (about PHP 243,750 per day) with no cap. Clause 17.1 also excludes LDs from the liability cap, so exposure is unlimited. A 10% cap would be reached after 20 days of delay.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: liquidated damages at the rate of one-half of one percent (0.5%) of the Contract Price for each calendar day of delay until Practical Completion is achieved.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Negotiate an LD cap of 10% of the Contract Price or less; meanwhile log uncapped LD exposure in the risk register and escalate.

checklist_items.title: Written variation procedure
checklist_items.finding: Variations must be instructed in writing and quoted for price and programme impact within 7 days (Clause 10.2).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: No Variation shall be valid unless instructed in writing by the Project Manager.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Use a change log; require the quotation before changed work starts.

checklist_items.title: Defects liability and warranties
checklist_items.finding: 12-month defects period with 14-day / 24-hour response times and manufacturer warranties assigned to the Employer.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Defects Liability Period is twelve (12) months from the date of Practical Completion.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Diarise the end of the defects period (31 Mar 2028) and collect warranties at handover.

checklist_items.title: Insurance covers full period
checklist_items.finding: Contractor's All Risk insurance covers the full Contract Price until the end of the defects period; third-party liability for the same period.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: for not less than the full Contract Price, from the Commencement Date until the end of the Defects Liability Period.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Obtain insurance certificates before 19 Oct 2026 and set expiry reminders.

checklist_items.title: Performance bond covers completion
checklist_items.finding: The performance bond expires on 28 Feb 2027, 31 days BEFORE Practical Completion (31 Mar 2027). Policy requires cover to at least PC + 28 days (28 Apr 2027). The last two months of work are unsecured.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The performance bond shall remain valid until 28 February 2027.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Require the bond to be extended to at least 28 Apr 2027 (or the end of the defects period) before mobilisation.

checklist_items.title: Liability cap and carve-outs
checklist_items.finding: Liability is capped at 100% of the Contract Price and consequential loss is excluded, but liquidated damages are carved out of the cap, which leaves delay exposure unlimited (see CHK-08).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: save for liquidated damages under Clause 12
checklist_items.suggested_action: Have Legal review the carve-out; bring LDs within the cap or add a separate LD cap.

checklist_items.title: Mutual, fault-based indemnities
checklist_items.finding: Each party indemnifies the other for its own negligence (Clauses 16.1 and 16.2).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Employer shall indemnify the Contractor against claims arising from the negligence of the Employer or its other contractors.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Confirm the insurance responds to these indemnities.

checklist_items.title: Balanced termination rights
checklist_items.finding: Employer may terminate on 14 days' notice for defined defaults; Contractor on 28 days' notice for non-payment; work done is paid on termination.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Upon termination, the Contractor shall be paid for work properly executed up to the date of termination
checklist_items.suggested_action: Record termination triggers and notice periods in the contract summary.

checklist_items.title: Force majeure incl. typhoon
checklist_items.finding: Typhoon, flood and earthquake are covered, with a 7-day notice and a 90-day long-stop termination right (Clause 20.3).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: including typhoon, earthquake, flood, fire, epidemic, war, civil disturbance and acts of government
checklist_items.suggested_action: Add typhoon-season risk to the risk register for Oct-Dec works.

checklist_items.title: Tiered dispute resolution
checklist_items.finding: Negotiation, then mediation, then construction arbitration; work continues during disputes.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Contractor shall continue to perform the Works during any dispute.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Record the escalation path and contacts in the stakeholder plan.

checklist_items.title: Subcontracting needs consent
checklist_items.finding: Employer consent is required and the Contractor stays responsible for subcontractors (Clause 18.2).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: The Contractor shall not subcontract any part of the Works without the prior written consent of the Employer
checklist_items.suggested_action: Keep an approved-subcontractor list and check licences.

checklist_items.title: Notices and notice periods
checklist_items.finding: Written notices with deemed-receipt rules; delay notice period is 14 days (within the 28-day limit).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: All notices shall be in writing and delivered by hand, courier or e-mail
checklist_items.suggested_action: Set up a correspondence register with notice-deadline reminders.

checklist_items.title: No automatic renewal
checklist_items.finding: The contract does not renew automatically; further works need a new agreement.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: This Contract shall not renew automatically.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Diarise the contract end (end of defects period and final account).

checklist_items.title: Every permit has an owner
checklist_items.finding: Clause 4.6 requires a Signage Permit, and Annex B lists it for MS-7, but it is in neither Part A (Contractor) nor Part B (Employer) of Annex C. Nobody is responsible for obtaining it.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Exterior signage on the Level 12 facade shall be installed only upon issuance of the Signage Permit by the City.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Assign the Signage Permit to a party by written instruction or amendment and add it to the RACI.

checklist_items.title: No work before permits; name and address rule
checklist_items.finding: The contract forbids work before a permit is valid and requires permits in the Employer's exact name and Site address (Clause 9.3).
checklist_items.evidence_quote: No part of the Works that requires a Permit shall commence before that Permit has been issued and is valid.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Make 'permit valid?' a gate in the work-start checklist.

checklist_items.title: Permits in force
checklist_items.finding: The Barangay Construction Clearance EXPIRED on 31 Aug 2026, before today and before mobilisation (MS-1, 19 Oct 2026). The other four permits on file are in force.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Valid Until | 31 August 2026
checklist_items.suggested_action: Employer to renew the Barangay Construction Clearance before 19 Oct 2026; do not mobilise without it.

checklist_items.title: Permit validity covers milestones
checklist_items.finding: MS-3 Electrical rough-in starts 16 Nov 2026, but the Electrical Permit only takes effect on 1 Dec 2026. That is 15 days of work scheduled before the permit is valid, which breaches Clause 9.4 and permit condition 1.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Valid From | 1 December 2026
checklist_items.suggested_action: Re-sequence MS-3 to start on or after 1 Dec 2026, or ask the issuing office to advance the effective date.

checklist_items.title: Permit holder name matches
checklist_items.finding: The Mechanical Permit is issued to 'Halcyon Ridge Holding Corp.', not the contracting party 'Halcyon Ridge Holdings, Inc.' Clause 9.3 requires the exact name. Other permits match.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Owner / Applicant | Halcyon Ridge Holding Corp.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Contractor to request a corrected Mechanical Permit before MS-4 (23 Nov 2026).

checklist_items.title: Permit site address matches
checklist_items.finding: The Mechanical Permit gives the address as 86 Sampaguita Ridge Avenue; the contract Site is 88 Sampaguita Ridge Avenue. Other permits match.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: 86 Sampaguita Ridge Avenue
checklist_items.suggested_action: Correct the address in the same amendment request as the holder name.

checklist_items.title: Permit scope covers contract scope
checklist_items.finding: Building, Electrical, Mechanical and Sanitary permit scopes match Annex A items A1-A7. The Electrical Permit does not mention data cabling containment (A3); this is usually not separately permitted, but worth confirming.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: New lighting, power outlets, two (2) distribution boards and associated wiring for office fit-out
checklist_items.suggested_action: Confirm with the electrical engineer that data containment needs no separate approval.

checklist_items.title: Permit conditions fit the schedule
checklist_items.finding: The Building Permit's after-hours noisy-works condition matches Clause 4.5 of the contract. Inspection hold points (electrical rough-in, plumbing pressure test) fit within the milestone durations.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Demolition and other noisy works shall be carried out only outside the building's business hours, as set by the Building Administration.
checklist_items.suggested_action: Add inspection hold points to the schedule and site induction.

checklist_items.title: All required permits on file
checklist_items.finding: The Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance is required (Annex C Part A, Contractor) for MS-6 starting 4 Jan 2027, but it is not on file and not in the Permit Register. The Signage Permit (MS-7) is also not on file.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance | Fire authority having jurisdiction
checklist_items.suggested_action: Instruct the Contractor to apply for the FSEC now and track weekly; block MS-6 until issued.

checklist_items.title: Renewal lead time planned
checklist_items.finding: The Sanitary/Plumbing Permit expires 15 Apr 2027, only 15 days after Practical Completion (policy buffer: 60 days). Its own condition requires renewal 30 days before expiry, i.e. by 16 Mar 2027 during commissioning.
checklist_items.evidence_quote: Valid Until | 15 April 2027
checklist_items.suggested_action: Assign a renewal owner and diarise the renewal application for 1 Mar 2027.
